text:
Dana Ortiz: Heads-up — Nimbus Co (midmarket) flagged: 67% usage dip overnight, trial ends in 9 days. Proposing a new 'giveback + accelerator handoff' play to reduce churn risk.

Liam Reed: _Giveback_ as in refund/credit? quick context on last activity?

Dana Ortiz: no refund. Giveback = short trial extension + low-touch accelerator (engineer-led micro-workshop) + clear reactivation path. Last activity: tried dataset sync, hit auth errors. Health 74->33. Billing not configured.

Olga Petrova: 33 is urgent. Love the accelerator angle. What's the concrete sequence?

Dana Ortiz: Outline: 1) Offer 14-day trial extension + keep workspace for 45 days (giveback window). 2) 40-min accelerator session with an engineer to fix auth + run 1 success. 3) 2k token grant + priority queue for 10 days. 4) Capture reasons via 2-question poll in-session. 5) Events to track: `giveback_started`, `accelerator_booked`, `auth_fixed`, `first_success_after_accelerator`.

Liam Reed: sounds solid. Make sure we don't over-commit on credits. Suggest 2000 tokens cap. Finance ok?

Billing Bot: Approval: credits up to 2500 tokens per account via playbook. Auto-provision flow required.

Dana Ortiz: great. Draft outreach snippet below — short, empathetic.

```
Hi {{first_name}},
We've paused billing pressure and added a 14-day extension so your team can finish setup. We'd also like to offer a complimentary 40-minute accelerator with one of our engineers to help fix the auth issue and run a successful test. We'll include a 2k token grant and priority support for 10 days. Book a slot: {{calendly}} or reply to accept the extension.
```

Olga Petrova: add a tiny pre-lab checklist in the booking confirmation: sample token, service account, sample dataset link. Also drop a GIF showing the auth flow.

Dana Ortiz: agreed. I'll ask Product to attach the GIF automatically when `giveback_started=true`.

CSPlaybook-bot: Action created: add_playbook 'giveback_accelerator' -> assignee Olga Petrova.

Liam Reed: instrumentation details — we'll need these events in the CS dashboard. Example payloads: 

```
{
  "event": "auth_fixed",
  "customer": "nimbus-co",
  "timestamp": 1772500100
}
```

Dana Ortiz: tagging @Billing Bot and @CSPlaybook-bot for provisioning and playbook entry. Also want an auto-nudge cadence: 48h post-booking, 7-day reminder, 3-day pre-expiry. If `first_success_after_accelerator` fires -> auto-schedule 1:1 health call.

Billing Bot: provisioning flow created. Need email template final and Calendly link to trigger.

Olga Petrova: I'll update playbook doc with templates, add rubric: use giveback-accelerator for accounts with recent auth/tech regressions and no billing set. Create two templates: extension offer + reactivation nudge.

Liam Reed: checklist before outreach: templates (Olga), Calendly (Olga), GIF + pre-lab checklist (Product), credit provisioning (Billing Bot), events wired (Liam), outreach (Dana).

Dana Ortiz: sending outreach now. Pinging Nimbus via email. Will post booking time and results here. :rocket:

Olga Petrova: PS capture quick reason tags in poll: `auth / data sync / unclear value / pricing / other` — makes follow-up routing easier.

Dana Ortiz: update 1772500220 — Nimbus replied and accepted the extension, booked accelerator for Fri 11am. Running play and will report back with outcomes.
